task_description: Your task is to generate a fcc lattice structure for Aluminum with a starting lattice constant 4.05 angstrom using lammps and calculate its cohesive_energy. The simulation should use metal units, define a 5x5x5 simulation box, set periodic boundary conditions to true, use EAM potential, save all coordinates and lattice parameters in structure.xyz file and print the final cohesive_energy of the structure after energy_minimisation. Use conjugate_gradient with energy tolerance upto 1.0e-4 and force_tolerance upto 1.0e-6 having maximum iterations as 100, and maximum evaluations as 100. All the potentials are saved in the directory /root/potentials, which in turn contains subdirectories by the material names, and each subdirectory contains various potentials for that material. For example, if you want to access potential for Cu, you can access it using /root/potentials/Cu/ which will contain various potentials, exact file name can vary and should be figured out. Save all the related files at /Users/chandan21gupta/Desktop/iit_delhi/agent_llms_3/mat-agent-bench/tasks/lammps/lammps/results/energy_minimization/task_1.

subtasks.name: directory_generation

subtasks.name: potential_path
subtasks.description: You are tasked with finding the absolute path of the EAM potential file for a given element. The potential files for all elements are stored in the directory /potentials/{element}/, where {element} is the symbol of the element (e.g., for Hydrogen, it would be H, and for Oxygen, it would be O)
